AMPLIFIERS
INSPECTION OF AMPLIFIER

INSPECT AMPLIFIER CIRCUIT

Disconnect the amplifier and inspect the connector on the wire harness side as shown in the chart below.

Test conditions:
(1) Ignition switch: ON
(2) Temperature control lever: MAX COOL
(3) Blower switch: HI

Check for | Tester connection | Condition | Specified value
Continuity | 10 — Ground | Constant | Continuity
Voltage | 2 — 10 | Turn A/C switch on. | Battery voltage
 | | Turn A/C switch off. | No voltage
Resistance | 6 — 9 | Constant | Approx. 1.5 kΩ at 25°C (77°F)

INSPECTION OF SYSTEM AMPLIFIER
(In A/C Control Panel Assembly)

1. False Signal Input to System Amplifier.

False Signal | A | B

Condition | Interior room temperature is very low. | Interior room temperature is very high.
